senses.zh_definition: 印度姓氏，规范书写为 Gaitonde；具体指谁须由上下文确定，例如画家 V. S. Gaitonde。
senses.en_definition: An Indian surname, conventionally capitalized Gaitonde; the person intended depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dari India yang ditulis sebagai Gaitonde; individu yang dirujuk ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 这里的 noun 表示专有名词，不是马来语普通名词。输入不足以锁定具体人物。画家只是可核实的例子，参见 [古根海姆博物馆展览介绍](https://www.guggenheim.org/exhibition/v-s-gaitonde-painting-as-process-painting-as-life-2)。下列是专名用例，不属于普通词汇的固定高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Gaitonde is encountered as a surname, including that of the Indian painter V. S. Gaitonde. The Guggenheim's retrospective places his work within Indian modern art and discusses his commitment to abstraction. This cultural association identifies one bearer of the name; it does not establish the surname's linguistic origin. Its historical derivation remains unverified here and should not be invented.
